name: Boba U4T
notes: Long pole. Made by Outemu. Gazzew's undisclosed "Boba plastic" blend. Comes in 62g and 68g; this is the 68g non-RGB with the original milky white housing (later versions are black). Actuation force isn't published. Travel is 4 mm at most vendors, but Pantheon lists 3.2 and 3.7 mm. Lightly lubed. Colors sampled from RNDKBD and Pantheon photos.
